```{r}
species <- c("monkey", "shark", "turkey", "snowman")
species_df <- tibble()

for (spp in species) {
  has_s <- startsWith(spp, "s")
  current_row <- tibble(
    Species = spp,
    Starts_with_S = has_s
  )
  species_df <- species_df |> bind_rows(current_row)
}
gt(species_df)
```

```{r}
breakfast <- c("eggs", "bacon", "sausages", "toast")
nums <- seq_len(5)
break_df <- tibble()
for (i in seq_len(10)) {
  item <- sample(breakfast, size = 1)
  num <- sample(nums, size = 1)
  row <- tibble(
    item = item,
    count = num
    )
  break_df <- bind_rows (break_df, row)
}
gt(break_df)
```

```{r}
coin_tosses <-sample(c("Heads", "Tails"),
                     size=5,
                     replace = TRUE)
                     print(coin_tosses)
```


```{r}
coin_tosses <-sample(c("Heads", "Tails"),
                     size=5,
                     replace=TRUE,

)
print(coin_tosses)
```

```{r}
vector <- sample(c("Badger", "Mushroom", "Snake"),
                 size = 100,
                 replace = TRUE,
                 prob = c(0.95, 0.04, 0.01))
print(vector)
```

```{r}
times <- 1000
numberpertime <- 200
count_pollinated_flowers <- rbinom(n = times, size = numberpertime, prob = 0.6)
times_successful <- sum(count_pollinated_flowers >= 125)
proportion <- times_successful/times
print(proportion)
```
```{r}
prob_under125 <- pbinom(124,200,0.6 )
probover125 <- 1-prob_under125
print(probover125)
```
